subject: maths
question: One pipe can fill a tank in 5 minutes while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 10 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, then how many minutes will it take to fill one-half of the tank?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total capacity of the tank = LCM of 5 and 10 = 10 units.

Efficiency of the filling pipe = 10 ÷ 5 = +2 units/min.

Efficiency of the emptying pipe = 10 ÷ 10 = −1 unit/min.

Combined net efficiency when both are open = 2 − 1 = +1 unit/min.

Time to fill half of the tank (5 units) = 5 ÷ 1 = 5 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 minutes.**
